original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports that stablecoin wallets are increasingly challenging traditional bank accounts as the primary consumer money hub. This infrastructure shift matters for $BTC because native onchain dollar settlement reduces reliance on banking rails, keeping liquidity parked directly inside the crypto ecosystem. Instead of capital exiting back to fiat after volatility, stablecoin balances create immediate spot buying power during compressed ranges. With Bitcoin holding steady near $78,985 as onchain settlement volume expands, is this structural liquidity floor enough to push the next leg up. Bullish, bearish, or wait Which asset is giving the clearest confirmation?
